summary:
The unchecked issuer copy in pgp_prt_params (src/lib.rs) was introduced by
upstream be1bece ("Correctly compute version 6 key IDs") and first
released in rpm-sequoia 1.9.0. Debian trixie ships 1.8.0-2, which predates
it: that code truncates any issuer to its last 8 bytes before copying, so
a long issuer subpacket cannot go out of bounds. Built 1.8.0 and 1.10.1 and
fed both an oversized Issuer subpacket: 1.8.0 parses it, 1.10.1 aborts.
The upstream fix (fa3c600, v1.10.2) assumes a typed KeyID and rejects every
issuer that is not 8 bytes. Backported to 1.8.0 (as +e1) it rejected the
20-byte fingerprint issuers gpg writes, breaking rpmsign.
Re-evaluate if this spec is ever rebased to rust-rpm-sequoia >= 1.9.0.
